## Summary / 变更摘要

<!-- Explain the user-visible outcome and why this change is needed. / 说明用户可见的结果以及为什么需要此改动。 -->

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm format:check`
- [ ] Relevant manual smoke check, when required / 已按需执行相关手动 smoke 检查

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The change is focused and I can explain every changed line. / 改动保持聚焦，我能解释每一处变更。
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior. / 测试覆盖了变更行为。
- [ ] Chinese and English UI strings remain aligned. / 中英文 UI 文案保持同步。
- [ ] Docs and shared IPC types are updated when behavior or contracts change. / 行为或接口变化时已更新文档和共享 IPC 类型。
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, logs, generated packages, or local config files are included. / 未包含密钥、私人路径、日志、生成安装包或本地配置文件。
- [ ] User-data, plaintext-secret, system-CLI-config, and download changes are called out above. / 上文已明确说明用户数据、明文密钥、系统 CLI 配置和下载相关变化。
